rules.statement: A bhikkhu is free to renounce his right to the management of a vihare, and such renunciation is valid according to both ecclesiastical law and common law.
rules.supporting_quote: "None of the authorities cited by Counsel support the proposition he was seeking to establish. There is nothing in the Vinaya or the decisions of this Court which forbids a bhikkhu from renouncing his right to the management of a vihare."
